title: Account attached
description: This event is generated when the Pismo platform finishes creating or locating the transaction banking account and successfully attaches the validated deposit product.

attach_datetime.title: Attach datetime
attach_datetime.description: The datetime when the account was attached

effective_date.title: Effective date
effective_date.description: The effective date of the attachment. Format = `YYYY-MM-DD`.

detach_datetime.title: Detach datetime
detach_datetime.description: Detach datetime. This field appears as `null` during attach events and is populated only during detach events.

interest_capitalization_mode.title: Interest Capitalization Mode
interest_capitalization_mode.description: How capitalized interest is treated for the attachment. `REINVEST` (default) or `PAYOUT`.

external_account_id.title: External account ID
external_account_id.description: A custom account ID string that uniquely identifies the account within your organization

maturity_period.title: Maturity period
maturity_period.description: Resolved maturity period for the attachment. The event always includes the fully resolved state (unit, value, and `calendar_maturity_date`). When the request omits maturity data, IBA‑API applies the product default, so this object is always populated.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Time unit of the maturity period. Used internally for rollover.

value.title: Value
value.description: Number of time units until maturity (>= 1). Used internally for rollover.

maturity_instructions.title: Maturity instructions
maturity_instructions.description: Instructions on how funds are processed once the maturity date is reached

principal.title: Principal
principal.description: How principal (initial investment) funds are processed once the maturity date is reached, it can be either `PAY` or `ROLLOVER`.

interest.title: Interest
interest.description: How interest funds are processed once the maturity date is reached, it can be either `PAY` or `ROLLOVER`.

overrides.title: Attachment overrides
overrides.description: A saved record of the per‑attachment overrides applied on top of the product defaults. This object appears only when at least one override was provided, and each field is included only if it was explicitly set.

maturity_instructions_override.title: Maturity instructions override
maturity_instructions_override.description: Override that controls the deposit's behavior at maturity. Any field you omit follows the normal fallback sequence, moving from the account level to the program and then to the product defaults.

principal.title: Principal
principal.description: Specifies how the principal is handled once the deposit matures

interest.title: Interest
interest.description: Specifies how the interest is handled once the deposit matures

renewal_term_override.title: Renewal term override
renewal_term_override.description: Recurring rollover term, not the same as the initial `maturity_period`. The response reflects the structure of the request. If you pass `unit` and `value`, those fields appear in the response. If `renewal_calendar_maturity_date` is passed, the response returns that date as a string.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Time unit of the renewal term

renewal_calendar_maturity_date.title: Renewal calendar maturity date
renewal_calendar_maturity_date.description: Returned only when the request uses the calendar format. Format = `YYYY-MM-DD`.

penalties_override.title: Penalties override
penalties_override.description: Saved overrides for each penalty type. Only types with configured overrides appear. Each entry includes `waived`, the relevant type‑specific fields, and an optional `valid_until` used for scheduled rollback.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Optional audit-trail reason for the entire penalties block.

grace_period_override.title: Grace period override
grace_period_override.description: Grace‑period override. Type‑specific fields are optional, and any field you omit follows the normal fallback sequence.

waived.title: Waived
waived.description: `true` if fully exempt; `false` when the penalty is active (customized via the fields below)

penalty_interest_days.title: Penalty interest days
penalty_interest_days.description: Number of interest days to forfeit as penalty

valid_until.title: Valid until
valid_until.description: Future ISO 8601 datetime. Schedules the revert of this override via EventBridge.

waived.title: Waived
waived.description: `true` if fully exempt; `false` when the penalty is active.

applicable_within_days.title: Applicable within days
applicable_within_days.description: Defines how many days after opening the penalty becomes applicable

penalty_interest_days.title: Penalty interest days
penalty_interest_days.description: Number of days multiplied by the applicable interest rate to determine the penalty

valid_until.title: Valid until
valid_until.description: Schedules the revert of this override. This value must be a future date and follows the ISO 8601 standard.

waived.title: Waived
waived.description: `true` if fully exempt; `false` when the penalty is active.

value.title: Value
value.description: Withdrawal fee value. Must be greater than 0.

valid_until.title: Valid until
valid_until.description: Schedules the revert of this override. This value must be a future date and follows the ISO 8601 standard.

tiered_interest_forfeiture_override.title: Tiered interest forfeiture override
tiered_interest_forfeiture_override.description: Tiered interest forfeiture override. Replaces the product tier when you pass this object.

waived.title: Waived
waived.description: `true` if fully exempt; `false` when the penalty is active.

tiers.title: Tiers
tiers.description: List of tier definitions. Each tier replaces the product's tier configuration.

valid_until.title: Valid until
valid_until.description: Schedules the revert of this override. This value must be a future date and follows the ISO 8601 standard.

tiered_interest_forfeiture_tier.title: Tiered interest forfeiture tier
tiered_interest_forfeiture_tier.description: Single tier in a tiered interest forfeiture override

min_days_held.title: Minimum days held
min_days_held.description: Minimum number of days the deposit must be held for this tier to apply

forfeited_interest_days.title: Forfeited interest days
forfeited_interest_days.description: Number of interest days to forfeit as penalty for this tier

max_days_held.title: Maximum days held
max_days_held.description: Maximum number of days the deposit can remain in this tier. If omitted, the tier has no maximum duration.

waived.title: Waived
waived.description: `true` if fully exempt; `false` when the penalty is active.

applicable_within_days.title: Applicable within days
applicable_within_days.description: Specifies how many days after a withdrawal the Pismo platform continues to treat a new withdrawal as penalty‑eligible

penalty_interest_days.title: Penalty interest days
penalty_interest_days.description: Number of interest days to forfeit as the penalty amount

window_behavior.title: Window behavior
window_behavior.description: Controls how the penalty window behaves after each withdrawal. `ROLLING` resets the window on every withdrawal, and `FIXED` sets it on the first withdrawal and keeps it unchanged.

valid_until.title: Valid until
valid_until.description: Schedules the revert of this override. This value must be a future date and follows the ISO 8601 standard.

product_id.title: Product ID
product_id.description: Pismo product ID in UUID v4 format

name.title: Product name
name.description: Name given to the product by the customer

interest_plan_id.title: Interest plan ID
interest_plan_id.description: Pismo interest plan ID in UUID v4 format

term_type.title: Term type
term_type.description: Type of deposit product term. This can be either `FIXED` or `FLEXIBLE`

created_at.title: Creation datetime
created_at.description: Deposit product creation date time. Represented as a RFC3339 timestamp.

cool_off_period.title: Cool-off period
cool_off_period.description: Period in days during which withdrawals are allowed without penalties

funding_duration.title: Funding duration
funding_duration.description: Period in days during which funds can be deposited into the account before operations are blocked

updated_at.title: Update Datetime
updated_at.description: Deposit product last update date time. Represented as a RFC3339 timestamp.

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Deposit product start date. The format is `YYYY-MM-DD`.

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Deposit product end date. The format is `YYYY-MM-DD`.

notices.title: Notices
notices.description: Maturity notices configured for the product

days_before_maturity.title: Days before maturity
days_before_maturity.description: Number of days before maturity when the notice is emitted

early_withdrawal_after_opening.title: Early withdrawal after opening
early_withdrawal_after_opening.description: Penalty applied when withdrawing shortly after opening

applicable_within_days.title: Applicable within days
applicable_within_days.description: How many days after opening the penalty becomes applicable

penalty_interest_days.title: Penalty interest days
penalty_interest_days.description: Number of interest days to forfeit as penalty

penalty_interest_days.title: Penalty interest days
penalty_interest_days.description: Number of interest days to forfeit as penalty

tiered_interest_forfeiture.title: Tiered interest forfeiture
tiered_interest_forfeiture.description: List of tier definitions for interest forfeiture

applicable_within_days.title: Applicable within days
applicable_within_days.description: How many days after a withdrawal a new withdrawal is treated as penalty-eligible

penalty_interest_days.title: Penalty interest days
penalty_interest_days.description: Number of interest days to forfeit as the penalty amount

window_behavior.title: Window behavior
window_behavior.description: Controls how the penalty window behaves after each withdrawal

deposit_tiered_interest_forfeiture_tier.title: Tiered interest forfeiture tier
deposit_tiered_interest_forfeiture_tier.description: Single tier in the product-level tiered interest forfeiture configuration

min_days_held.title: Min days held
min_days_held.description: Minimum number of days the deposit must be held for this tier to apply

max_days_held.title: Max days held
max_days_held.description: Maximum number of days the deposit can remain in this tier

forfeited_interest_days.title: Forfeited interest days
forfeited_interest_days.description: Number of interest days to forfeit as penalty for this tier
